description: Audita um ART vault (dpo2u-solana art-vault program) para conformidade MiCAR — Proof of Reserve (Art. 36), Liquidity Vault (Art. 39), Capital Buffer 3% (Art. 35), Velocity Limiter (Art. 23). Retorna diagnóstico JSON com scores, missing_controls e recommendations.
